title: ClinicFrame
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
gap: Every product in this category is priced and shaped for a practice with an IT person: per-seat EHR modules, an integration project, a template library someone has to maintain. The one-room clinic that would benefit most is the one that cannot start. And in China the whole category is missing: the private 中医馆 / 牙科 / 康复 clinic writes its notes into a WeChat note or a paper book, and no ambient scribe speaks to that workflow at all.

zh.gap: 这个品类里所有产品都是按「你有个 IT」来定价和设计的：按人头收费的模块、一场对接项目、一套要有人维护的模板库。最需要它的那间单人诊所，恰恰是启动不了的那间。中文侧更是整块空着：私人中医馆／牙科／康复门诊的病历写在微信备忘录和纸本子上，没有任何一款随诊记录产品对着这个流程说话。
zh.pain: 一个人开的诊所，老板既是医生也是前台也是文书。写病历不是他的本职，却决定他能不能拿到钱、会不会出事，所以它每天都发生在下班之后，免费。
zh.kill: 大厂把这件事做成他们本来就强制打包的那套系统里的一个勾选项；而病历一旦错过一次，医生就永远不再信它——它的失败形态不是「不好用」，是责任。医疗文书还牵进消费级产品里最重的数据义务，这是唯一一条「先跑起来再说」明确是错的赛道。
zh.move: 不要卖系统，卖回那九十分钟：一间屋、一个医生、不对接、不配置模板，交付物就是今晚的病历已经写好、格式是他自己的医保或监管方要的那个，外加一页「还需要你签名确认的地方」。自限写死：只转写、只结构化、只标出待确认，绝不下诊断、绝不给医嘱建议，临床判断永远退回给医生。冷启动（中文）：小红书／知乎「私人诊所 病历 加班」「中医馆 病历 怎么写」，以及口腔器械经销号背后的诊所老板群；（英文）：r/dentistry、r/physicaltherapy、r/privatepractice 里单人诊所互相打听「你花多少钱请人写病历」的帖子。
zh.hook: 自己开一间屋子的牙医或中医：他同时是医生、前台和文书员，最后一个病人走了之后，晚上九点开始补病历，没人付这段时间的钱。这件事附近已经有人在花钱了——要么是一套只用得上十分之一的按人头收费的系统，要么是一个按小时算的帮手。
zh.does: 单间诊所的随诊记录员：听完这场问诊，直接把病历和该报的文书写完，没有任何要配置的东西。
zh.consumer_angle: 使用者是一个恰好是医生的小老板，不是医院信息科。他拿到的成品是一个不用加班的晚上。

pain: The owner-operator of a one-room clinic is also the receptionist and the records clerk. The documentation is not the job but it decides whether they get paid and whether they are in trouble, so it happens after hours, every night, for free.
kill: Epic, Cerner and their Chinese equivalents ship this as one checkbox in a suite the clinic is already forced to buy, and the moment a note is wrong once the clinician stops trusting it forever — the failure mode is not annoyance, it is liability. Medical documentation also drags in the heaviest data-handling duties of any consumer-adjacent product; this is the one lane where 'move fast' is the wrong instinct.
move: Do not sell an EHR. Sell the ninety minutes back: one room, one clinician, no integration, no template setup — the deliverable is tonight's notes already written, in the format their own regulator or insurer expects, and a one-page 'what still needs your signature'. Self-limit hard: transcribe, structure and flag, never diagnose and never advise; anything clinical stays a question for the clinician. Cold start (Chinese): 小红书/知乎 「私人诊所 病历 加班」「中医馆 病历 怎么写」and the owner groups behind 口腔诊所 supplier accounts; (English): r/dentistry, r/physicaltherapy and r/privatepractice threads where solo owners compare what they pay for scribing.
hook: A dentist or TCM practitioner who owns the room they work in: they are the clinician, the front desk and the records clerk, and the notes get written at nine at night, unpaid, after the last patient leaves. They already pay for this — either a per-seat EHR they use one-tenth of, or an hourly hand.
does: Ambient scribe for a single-room clinic: it listens to the consultation and hands back the finished note plus the compliance paperwork, with nothing to configure.
consumer_angle: The user is a small-business owner who happens to be a clinician — not a hospital IT department. The finished thing they walk away with is a night off.
